question_that_must_be_answered: Do you have written permission, or a licence, to collect and republish NFL data?
why_it_blocks_a_decision: Until this is answered, every published NFL value is a possible terms breach, and no collection can be expanded or automated
known_now_source_backed: NFL.com Terms section 1.3 states that systematic retrieval to compile a collection, compilation, database or directory is prohibited absent express prior written consent
how_to_discover: Write to the NFL for permission, or negotiate a licence with a data provider, or keep the site to source-linked summaries only
the_choice_you_will_face: Approve a licence route, approve a permission request, or restrict the site to summaries

question_that_must_be_answered: Is a skill contest with rewards lawful where you are, and which design is lawful?
why_it_blocks_a_decision: A leaderboard with rewards is the part of the brief most exposed to gambling and advertising law, and no reviewer has examined it
known_now_source_backed: Government of Japan states that betting on sports online from Japan is a criminal gambling offence and that advertising or guiding users to it was made illegal from 25 September 2025; this is Japan-specific
how_to_discover: Obtain a written opinion from a qualified lawyer in the relevant jurisdiction, covering rewards, entry, advertising and age limits
the_choice_you_will_face: Proceed, change the design, or run a no-reward research leaderboard

question_that_must_be_answered: What exactly is the reward, who funds it, and what must a winner prove?
why_it_blocks_a_decision: A reward you cannot lawfully pay, or cannot verify, turns the leaderboard into a promise you may not keep
known_now_source_backed: Nothing is defined, funded or approved; the site states that no reward exists
how_to_discover: Decide the form (recognition only, or a funded prize), the eligibility proof and the terms
the_choice_you_will_face: Recognition only, a funded prize, or no leaderboard rewards

question_that_must_be_answered: Which authorized source will supply timestamped prices, and what may be republished?
why_it_blocks_a_decision: Without a price you cannot compute an edge, closing-line value or any performance metric
known_now_source_backed: No licensed odds feed exists in this repository; NFL Support says its odds widgets are partner-provided, not a public archive
how_to_discover: Buy a licensed historical odds feed, or record your own observations at the moment you see them, or stay forecast-only
the_choice_you_will_face: A licensed feed, a self-recorded observation log, or forecast-only research

question_that_must_be_answered: Will you accept the official gamebook as the starter-identity source?
why_it_blocks_a_decision: The whole depth-deficiency requirement depends on knowing who actually started; the gamebook settles it after the fact
known_now_source_backed: Verified: the official NFL gamebook for Washington at New York Giants lists the full starting lineup, substitutions, Did Not Play and Not Active, and 19 rows from it are recorded here
how_to_discover: Collect the official gamebook for every game in the study, week by week
the_choice_you_will_face: Gamebook-based role evidence, or a licensed participation feed

question_that_must_be_answered: Do you need a pregame depth order, or is post-game starter identity enough?
why_it_blocks_a_decision: A pregame depth chart would let you model a probable lineup before the game; the gamebook only tells you what happened
known_now_source_backed: No official NFL page publishes a pregame depth chart; the official roster page has no depth column (verified)
how_to_discover: Use the previous week's gamebook starters as the pregame expectation, or licence a provider that publishes depth charts
the_choice_you_will_face: Previous-gamebook expectation, a licensed depth chart, or leave the rank blank

question_that_must_be_answered: Do you have an official statement of what Out, Doubtful and Questionable mean?
why_it_blocks_a_decision: If you assume a probability for each label, every availability feature is built on an assumption you cannot cite
known_now_source_backed: NFL.com displays the three labels without published probabilities; no official policy text was located (Flag F04)
how_to_discover: Ask the NFL for the injury-report policy, or avoid assigning probabilities and treat the labels as categorical only
the_choice_you_will_face: Treat the labels as categories, or model probabilities you can cite

question_that_must_be_answered: How often will you capture the report, and at what exact time?
why_it_blocks_a_decision: A forecast is only reproducible if you know what was visible at the cutoff; the official page shows no update time
known_now_source_backed: The page states Week 10 without a last-updated timestamp (Flag F13); the snapshot is dated by day only
how_to_discover: Record your own capture time for every read and store it with the row
the_choice_you_will_face: A single pre-kickoff capture, or a multi-day capture series

question_that_must_be_answered: How many seasons of history will the study use?
why_it_blocks_a_decision: Every statistical gate needs enough independent games; one week cannot support any conclusion
known_now_source_backed: The repository holds one week of verified data, 14 games, and no historical results
how_to_discover: Collect several seasons of schedules and gamebooks, or licence an archive
the_choice_you_will_face: One season forward test, or a multi-season archive

question_that_must_be_answered: What is the benchmark every strategy must beat?
why_it_blocks_a_decision: Without a declared baseline, no result can be called an improvement
known_now_source_backed: A baseline rule is defined (league mean, and the verified availability signal alone) but nothing has been scored
how_to_discover: Declare the baseline in writing before any evaluation
the_choice_you_will_face: League-mean baseline, availability-only baseline, or both

question_that_must_be_answered: Which single pre-declared metric ranks strategies?
why_it_blocks_a_decision: If the metric changes after the results, the winner can be manufactured
known_now_source_backed: The rule is fixed that a probability metric with an interval is used, not total winnings; the metric name is blank
how_to_discover: Choose one metric and freeze it for the season
the_choice_you_will_face: A calibration-based score, a closing-line value, or an error metric

question_that_must_be_answered: What is the smallest eligible sample that may appear on the leaderboard?
why_it_blocks_a_decision: A leaderboard of tiny samples measures luck; the minimum must be set before results exist
known_now_source_backed: NIST gives 500 resamples as a usual bootstrap size but sets no domain minimum; the project minimum is blank
how_to_discover: Pre-declare the minimum N from a power or precision argument, not from the observed data
the_choice_you_will_face: A minimum N, or no minimum with an explicit warning

question_that_must_be_answered: What happens to strategies you tried and discarded?
why_it_blocks_a_decision: The best of many untracked attempts looks skilful by construction
known_now_source_backed: The rules require a published search log; none exists yet
how_to_discover: Log every attempt in the repository at the time you make it
the_choice_you_will_face: Full disclosure, or a pre-registered limited set of attempts

question_that_must_be_answered: Which paired data will you use to measure dependence between legs?
why_it_blocks_a_decision: Parlay and combo pricing is only defensible if dependence is measured rather than assumed
known_now_source_backed: No paired settled data exists, so every correlation cell is blank (C01-C10)
how_to_discover: Obtain settled paired outcomes from an authorized provider, with the exact market definitions
the_choice_you_will_face: Measure dependence from licensed settled legs, or restrict to single bets

question_that_must_be_answered: Where will you get the written settlement rules for each market?
why_it_blocks_a_decision: Push, void and stat-correction rules change the return of the same ticket
known_now_source_backed: No provider rule text is attached to this project
how_to_discover: Collect the provider's written rules for every market you model
the_choice_you_will_face: Model settlement explicitly, or avoid markets with void and correction risk

question_that_must_be_answered: Which unit counts as one observation, game or leg?
why_it_blocks_a_decision: Legs inside one game are not independent; treating them as independent overstates confidence
known_now_source_backed: The clustering rule is defined (resample by week or game) but nothing has been computed
how_to_discover: Apply cluster resampling in the evaluation code
the_choice_you_will_face: Game-clustered, week-clustered, or unclustered with a warning

question_that_must_be_answered: What exactly may appear on the public site, and how long is it lagged?
why_it_blocks_a_decision: A published live pick is advice, not research, and inherits liability and rights exposure
known_now_source_backed: The site is research-only and lagged in principle; the lag period is blank
how_to_discover: Fix the lag and the labels before publishing any entry
the_choice_you_will_face: Lagged research entries, or no public entries

question_that_must_be_answered: How many mismatches between sources is acceptable before a row is withheld?
why_it_blocks_a_decision: Two official pages already disagree about one player's position, so a rule is needed
known_now_source_backed: Verified: the injury report lists Ben Brown as C while his official player page lists G; the snapshot keeps the declared page's value
how_to_discover: Set a written rule for which source wins and when a row is flagged
the_choice_you_will_face: Declared-source-wins, or withholds any conflicting row

question_that_must_be_answered: Who checks the transcribed rows, and how often?
why_it_blocks_a_decision: Manual transcription is the weakest link in the data chain; one missed name changes an exposure count
known_now_source_backed: A field-by-field comparison now exists and passed 345 of 345 rows, but it is still produced by the same session that transcribed the rows
how_to_discover: Independent re-transcription by a second person or an approved API
the_choice_you_will_face: Independent re-check, or accept the current control

question_that_must_be_answered: Is this a research site, a personal decision tool, or a published product?
why_it_blocks_a_decision: The answer changes the rights, the disclaimers and the legal review needed
known_now_source_backed: The site currently presents research only and states it is not betting advice
how_to_discover: Decide the scope in writing and align every page to it
the_choice_you_will_face: Research only, private tool, or published product

decision_topic: Which register governs a duplicated brief line
question_that_must_be_answered: When the same brief line appears on two requirement rows with different readiness verdicts, which verdict is the one a reader should act on?
why_it_blocks_a_decision: The readiness table is the page that tells you what to do next. Where one brief line has two answers (Done and Missing; Blocked and Partial), a reader cannot act on it without knowing which governs.
known_now_source_backed: Measured in-repo on 2026-11-19: 65 requirement rows, 57 distinct brief statements, 8 duplicate groups, 7 with divergent answers (data/requirements_duplicate_groups.csv, F131). No external source is needed to see this.
how_to_discover: Read data/requirements_duplicate_groups.csv; each group lists both IDs, both verdicts and both file line numbers. Then choose a rule: keep both IDs with one declared authoritative answer (no renumbering), or merge them.
the_choice_you_will_face: Keep both IDs and declare one authoritative answer per group (recommended, no renumbering), merge and renumber, or relabel the table as rows rather than requirements
